content_zh:
听见她这句话，玄渊冷硬的面容有了一丝丝变化，只是他依然眉头紧皱，目光灼灼地盯着她。

原嘉宁被他看得有些失措，莫名地心虚，自从玄渊十岁那年被从原府带走，他和她之间就早已不是姐弟，她也只不过是紧咬着曾经是姐弟当做借口，用来抵抗玄渊这让她慌乱异常的感觉而已。

「听说，你前天真的去相亲了？」玄渊正值变声期，嗓音有些沙哑，却意外的带了几分磁性，非但不难听，反而在靠近原嘉宁的耳朵逼问时，更让她面红耳赤起来。

原嘉宁伸手推他，让两人之问保持一段距离，才恼怒地说：「是啊，我去相亲了，如今你我非亲非故，这又关你什么事？」

第2章(2)

玄渊的眉头越皱越紧，他握紧了拳头，指尖深深刻进掌心，带来麻木的疼痛。

他低声质问：「非亲非故？我在你心里已经成了非亲非故之人？」

原嘉宁躲避开他那令人心惊的咄咄逼人眼神，依然忍不住羞恼，道：「难道不是吗？你如今是高高在上的太子殿下，而我不过是一个普通的世族女子而已。」

玄渊闭了闭眼睛，让那阵让自己气怒攻心的黑暗感觉慢慢消散，才沉郁地说：「你是生我的气了吧？因为我曾经说了『娶谁都好，就是不娶原嘉宁』这句话？」

原嘉宁低下头，咬紧了嘴唇。

玄渊伸手去握她纤细嫩白的玉手，却被她闪过，玄渊干脆直接将她揽进怀里，紧紧抱住，如今的他已经比她整整高了一个头，她就是要挣也挣脱不了。

「放开！你放开我！」原嘉宁的心更发慌，脸更红了，她简直要被玄渊弄胡涂了，他明明那样无情拒绝了她，现在这样又是为何？

「嘉宁。」玄渊埋首在她的玉颈之中，发出闷闷的声音。「嘉宁。」

这是他第一次这样叫她的名字，原嘉宁几乎要窒息，她挣扎的力度渐渐减弱，慢慢便不再动了，任凭他紧抱着她，听着他一声声的呼唤，泪水慢慢盈满了她的眼。

他怎么可以这样对她？

当着皇帝的面狠心拒绝了她，现在又来撩拨引诱她，到底把她当成什么？

她虽然性格温柔，却并非烂好人，之所以对着他一而再，再而三的心软让步，心甘情愿为他一针一线地缝制衣衫，最初或许是出于对他离奇身世的怜悯，可是后来看着这个文雅的少年一天天成长，变得冷硬，变得孤独，明明高高在上了，却经常在她面前流露出困兽一般无助的眼神，让她一点点心疼，一点点心怜，就这样一点点地将他烙印在了自己心上。

她是真的不愿意嫁入皇宫，她万分讨厌皇帝的三宫六院，但她以前便隐约猜到了皇帝和父母的企图。玄渊和原府根本就分不清彼此，联姻会更加深两者的联系，能给孤独无助的他一份助力。

那时她其实的确隐约想过若皇帝指婚，且也是父母之命的话，就算再讨厌皇宫，为了「原琅」，她或许能容忍、让步。

为了他，她愿意嫁入皇宫，愿意忍受众多嫔妃，她真的这样想过。

可是薛冰莹传来的话，彻底让她心寒，也让她明白了自己是如何自作多情，错许芳心，人家根本就不领她的情！

当薛冰莹说出「娶谁都好，就是不娶你」时，那一刻她真恨不得一头撞死。

「对不起，我其实不是那个意思，只是那话就脱口而出了，后来很难再解释清楚。」玄渊轻轻推开她一些，双手捧住她泪水满面的小脸，再也忍不住心头的激荡，猛然低头吻下去。

原嘉宁被他如此突兀的行为吓住，甚至忘记了抗拒，只傻傻地瞪大了眼睛，看着猛然靠近的英俊脸庞。她的双唇被狠狠压住，玄渊笨拙又发狠地在她娇嫩的嘴唇上来回磨蹭，滚烫的吻随后又蔓延到她的脸颊上，将她的泪水全部吻去，之后他又吻回她的双唇，贪婪又急切地吮吸含咬。

他也不太懂得如何亲吻，只是凭着本能想与自己心爱的女孩再亲密一点。

他的手紧紧楼着她的纤腰，那种恨不能把她揉进自己身体的渴切，直接反应在他的身体上，虽然冬日衣服穿得厚，原嘉宁还是隐隐察觉出来不妥，等她明白那抵在自己小腹处的硬挺是什么时，轰一下整个人都快烧了起来。

她清醒了一点，急切慌乱地开始反抗，用尽力气推着玄渊，说：「你疯了？放开我！放开我！」

可是情窦初开、情欲初起的少年既然品尝到了心上人的滋味，哪里还愿放开？玄渊依然试图吻她、抱她，手中的动作也不由加了几分力气，原嘉宁被勒痛了，忍不住哀鸣出声，叫道：「原琅！」

这个名字让玄渊猛地清醒过来，他停下动作，头抵在原嘉宁的肩膀上，呼吸沉重而急促。

良久，他才慢慢直起了身子，叹了口气。

原嘉宁立即后退三步，离他远远的，目光警戒地盯着他，唯恐他再乱来。

玄渊说：「早知如此，我又何必说出那话伤了你。」

原嘉宁眨了眨眼，迷糊不解。

玄渊无奈地扁了扁嘴角，说：「你曾经教训过我和二弟、三弟，要我们日后长大了要学习父亲和二叔、三叔，做一个善待妻子的忠贞丈夫，你日后的梦想也是嫁一个这样的夫君，希望自己与夫君都能够从一而终，白首偕老，不是吗？」

原嘉宁点了点头，这确实是她的理想。

或者说，这是天下大多数女子的理想，只是真正能够实现的，又有几个呢？

玄渊的眼神幽暗，继绩说：「现在的我，还会是你的良人之选吗？一入宫门深似海，多少恩怨不由人。你可知道，现在在我的东宫里，皇上已经赐给了我两个侍寝宫女，皇后也赏了两个，美其名教导我成人，而且还有其他的宫女和千金贵女，多到不胜数。嘉宁……你可知道，我是不想日后负你，才狠心今日拒绝你。」

原嘉宁瞪大了眼睛，她千想万想，怎么也想不到玄渊会是因为这样的理由才拒绝了她。

「皇宫里，美女成群，丽人成堆，可是红颜枯骨更是不知多少，我原本不想你跟着我受罪，只希望你真能嫁给一位如父亲这样的男人，平安喜乐地过一辈子。」玄渊握紧了手心，目光灼灼地盯着她，「我是真的这样想过，我也以为自己真的可以做到，谨守着弟弟的身分，看着你嫁给良人，默默守护你的幸福。我以为我自己真的可以这么伟大，这么无私！」

原嘉宁咬紧了嘴唇，眼泪再次模糊了她的视线。

她愿意为了他入宫，甘愿忍受日后他必然会有的众多妃嫔；他却为了她而拒绝她，想成全她「一生一代一双人」的美好梦想。

他们都全心全意为了对方着想，结果却背道而驰，为什么？

「那你为什么不坚持下去？你今夜为什么还要见我？」原嘉宁泪眼朦胧地质问，既然他要装出伟大的情操，为什么不装到底？为什么还要来招惹她？

「我……」玄渊低头，指甲划过掌心，那种疼痛让他终于放下了男人所谓的自尊，说：「我输了，我办不到！我没有自己所想的那么伟大，那么无私。我无法眼睁睁看着你嫁给别人，哪怕只听说你要和别人议亲了，我就已经忍受不了了！」原嘉宁一时百感交集，脸上的表情更是似哭似笑难以分辨。
content_en:
Hearing her words, Xuan Yuan's cold face changed slightly, but he still frowned and stared at her with burning eyes.

Yuan Jianing was a little confused by what he saw, and felt inexplicably guilty. Ever since Xuan Yuan was taken away from Yuan Mansion when he was ten years old, he and she had no longer been siblings. She was just clinging to the fact that they were siblings as an excuse to resist Xuan Yuan's feeling of panic and abnormality in her.

"I heard that you really went on a blind date the day before yesterday?" Xuan Yuan was in the period of changing his voice. His voice was a little hoarse, but unexpectedly a little magnetic. Not only was it not unpleasant to listen to, but it made Yuan Jianing blush even more when he asked Yuan Jianing's ear.

Yuan Jianing stretched out his hand to push him, keeping the distance between the two of them, and then said angrily: "Yes, I went on a blind date. Now you and I are not relatives, so what does it have to do with you?"

Chapter 2(2)

Xuan Yuan's brows furrowed tighter and tighter. He clenched his fists, and his fingertips dug deeply into his palms, causing numb pain.

He asked in a low voice: "Not a relative but not a friend? I have become a person who is neither a relative nor a friend in your heart?"

Yuan Jianing avoided his frightening and aggressive look, but still couldn't help but feel embarrassed and said, "Isn't it true? You are now the high-ranking Crown Prince, and I am just an ordinary woman from a noble family."

Xuan Yuan closed his eyes and let the dark feeling that made him angry slowly dissipate, and then he said gloomily: "Are you angry with me? Because I once said, 'I can marry anyone, but not Yuan Jianing'?"

Yuan Jianing lowered his head and bit his lips.

Xuan Yuan reached out to hold her slender and white jade hand, but she dodged it. Xuan Yuan simply took her into his arms and hugged her tightly. Now he was a whole head taller than her, and she couldn't get away even if she tried.

"Let go! Let me go!" Yuan Jianing's heart became even more panicked and her face turned redder. She was almost confused by Xuan Yuan. He had clearly rejected her so ruthlessly, so why was he like this now?

"Jianing." Xuan Yuan buried his head in her jade neck and made a muffled voice."Jianing."

This was the first time he called her name like this. Yuan Jianing almost suffocated. Her struggle gradually weakened and she stopped moving. She let him hold her tightly and listened to his calls, tears slowly filled her eyes.

How could he do this to her?

He cruelly rejected her in front of the emperor, and now he came to tease and seduce her. What did he take her to be?

Although she has a gentle personality, she is not a bad person. The reason why she gave in to him again and again and was willing to sew clothes for him stitch by stitch was initially out of pity for his bizarre life experience, but later when she saw this elegant manThe boy grew up day by day, became cold, hard, and lonely. Although he was superior, he often showed helpless eyes like a trapped animal in front of her, which made her feel a little distressed and pity him, and in this way, he was imprinted on her heart little by little.

She really didn't want to marry into the palace. She hated the emperor's three palaces and six courtyards, but she had vaguely guessed the intentions of the emperor and her parents before.Xuan Yuan and Yuan Fu can't tell each other apart at all. Marriage will deepen the connection between the two and give him help when he is lonely and helpless.

At that time, she did vaguely think that if the emperor proposed the marriage and it was also ordered by her parents, no matter how much she hated the palace, she might be able to tolerate and compromise for the sake of "Yuan Lang".

For him, she was willing to marry into the palace and endure many concubines. She really thought about it.

But what Xue Bingying said completely chilled her heart. It also made her understand how she had been so sentimental and wronged Xu Fang's heart, and people simply didn't accept her love!

When Xue Bingying said, "I can marry anyone, but I won't marry you." At that moment, she really wanted to hit her to death.

"I'm sorry, I didn't actually mean it. It was just that those words came out of my mouth, and it was difficult to explain clearly later." Xuan Yuan gently pushed her away, holding her tear-stained face with both hands. He could no longer hold back the excitement in his heart, and suddenly lowered his head to kiss her.

Yuan Jianing was so frightened by his sudden behavior that she even forgot to resist. She just widened her eyes stupidly and looked at the handsome face that suddenly approached.Her lips were pressed hard, Xuan Yuan clumsily and ruthlessly rubbed back and forth on her delicate lips, and then the hot kiss spread to her cheeks, kissing away all her tears. Then he kissed her lips back, sucking and biting greedily and eagerly.

He didn't really know how to kiss, he just wanted to be closer to the girl he loved based on his instinct.

His hands were tightly holding her slender waist, and the desire to rub her into his body was directly reflected on his body. Although he wore thick winter clothes, Yuan Jianing still vaguely noticed something was wrong. When she understood what the hardness against her lower abdomen was, her whole body was about to burn.

She woke up a little and began to resist in a panic. She pushed Xuan Yuan with all her strength and said, "Are you crazy? Let me go! Let me go!"

But now that the young man has just tasted the taste of his sweetheart, how can he still be willing to let go?Xuan Yuan still tried to kiss her and hug her, and he couldn't help but add a little more force to his movements. Yuan Jianing was in pain, and couldn't help but whine, shouting: "Yuan Lang!"

This name made Xuan Yuan wake up suddenly. He stopped moving and rested his head on Yuan Jianing's shoulder. His breathing was heavy and rapid.

After a long time, he slowly straightened up and sighed.

Yuan Jianing immediately took three steps back, staying far away from him, staring at him warily, lest he mess up again.

Xuan Yuan said: "If I had known this, why would I have hurt you by saying those words."

Yuan Jianing blinked, confused.

Xuan Yuan flattened his lips helplessly and said, "You once taught me and my second and third brothers that when we grow up, we should learn from our father and our second and third uncles and be a loyal husband who treats his wife well. Your dream in the future is to marry such a husband. You hope that you and your husband can stay together and grow old together, right?"

Yuan Jianing nodded, this was indeed her ideal.

In other words, this is the ideal of most women in the world, but how many can actually be realized?

Xuan Yuan's eyes were dark, and Ji Ji said: "Am I still the choice of your beloved? Once you enter the palace, it is as deep as the sea, and there are so many grudges that cannot be controlled by anyone. Do you know that now in my East Palace, the emperor has given me two attendants?The queen also rewarded me with two palace maids, in the name of educating me, and there are countless other palace maids and rich ladies, Jianing... you know, I don’t want to let you down in the future, so I cruelly refuse you today.”

Yuan Jianing's eyes widened. She thought a lot, but she never imagined that Xuan Yuan would reject her for such a reason.

"In the palace, there are many beauties and beauties, but there are even more beauties with dead bones. I didn't want you to suffer along with me. I just hoped that you could really marry a man like your father and live a peaceful and happy life." Xuan Yuan clenched his palms.Staring at her with stern eyes, "I really thought about it, and I thought I could really do it. I would keep my identity as a younger brother, watch you marry your beloved, and silently protect your happiness. I thought I could really be so great and selfless!"

Yuan Jianing bit her lips, tears blurring her vision again.

She was willing to enter the palace for him, and she was willing to endure the many concubines he would inevitably have in the future; but he rejected her for her sake, wanting to fulfill her beautiful dream of "two people for a lifetime."

They both thought of each other wholeheartedly, but in the end they went in opposite directions. Why?

"Then why don't you persist? Why do you still want to see me tonight?" Yuan Jianing asked with tears in his eyes. Since he wanted to pretend to be a great sentiment, why not pretend to the end?Why bother with her again?

"I..." Xuan Yuan lowered his head and scratched his palms with his nails. The pain made him finally let go of his so-called self-esteem and said, "I lost, I can't do it! I'm not as great and selfless as I thought. I can't watch you marry someone else. Even if I just heard that you were planning to marry someone else, I couldn't stand it anymore!" Yuan Jianing had mixed feelings at the moment, and the expression on his face was even more difficult to distinguish between crying and laughing.
